name: io.github.dsouzaanush/heroku-code-mcp
title: Heroku Code MCP
description: Search and execute Heroku Platform API operations

environmentVariables.name: HOST
environmentVariables.description: Bind the local MCP HTTP server to localhost.

environmentVariables.name: PORT
environmentVariables.description: Local port for the streamable HTTP MCP endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: USER_ID
environmentVariables.description: User id sent to the MCP server in the x-user-id header.

environmentVariables.name: TOKEN_STORE_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to the encrypted Heroku token store.

environmentVariables.name: TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY_BASE64
environmentVariables.description: Base64-encoded 32-byte key for the token store.

environmentVariables.name: ALLOW_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Allow confirmed mutating Heroku API operations.

environmentVariables.name: WRITE_CONFIRMATION_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Secret used to sign dry-run write confirmation tokens.

headers.name: x-user-id
headers.description: Selects the Heroku token store entry for this client session.
